newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber edges up in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber edges up in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices edged higher in slow late trading on Monday, following early Singapore buying in Medan, traders said.

"Demand appeared to pick up today, while supply remained largely sufficient. Any possible further upside is likely to be limited," one trader said. Traders said Singapore dealers bought SIR20 fob Medan at 47.00 U.S. cents/lb for July/August shipments, up 0.25 cents against the previous 46.75 cents.
Offer prices rose 0.25 cents to 47.25 fob Medan, 46.50 fob Padang, 46.75 fob Surabaya and 46.25 fob Jambi and Pontianak.
